product_metadata.title: Linon Talia Charcoal Office Chair, Gray
features: Stylish and comfortable option for office seating.
Grey washed base and sleek black hooded castors.
Gas lift, mechanism, and casters with BIFMA Standard.
This office chair was tested to have up to a 275 lb. weight capacity.
Adjustable Seat Height: 19"- 23"H. - Seat dimensions: 22"W x 18.75"D.
Button tufted back, in a charcoal colored fabric with accented silver nail-heads.
description: Add style and function to your office with the Talia Office Chair. The soft, plush frame features a button-tufted back upholstered in charcoal gray with silver nailhead accents. A sturdy washed wood base is set on metal casters for easy mobility around your office space. An adjustable seat height ensures this chair works for a variety of table heights. Perfect for a home workspace or an added touch of comfort at the office.
